# Visit Maroon Bells

> Official reservation system for shuttle service, parking, and wilderness permits to access the iconic Maroon Bells peaks and Maroon Bells-Snowmass Wilderness near Aspen, Colorado.

Visit Maroon Bells manages the seasonal access reservation system for one of Colorado's most photographed destinations, coordinating shuttle transportation from Aspen Highlands, parking at Maroon Lake Trailhead, wilderness permits, and campground reservations through Recreation.gov and the U.S. Forest Service.

## Key Topics

- Maroon Bells Scenic Area
- Shuttle reservations and transportation
- Maroon Creek Road access
- Wilderness permits and backpacking
- Recreation.gov booking system
- Maroon Bells-Snowmass Wilderness
- Four Pass Loop trail
- Maroon Lake Trailhead
- Campground reservations (Silver Bar, Silver Queen, Silver Bell)
- Seasonal vehicle restrictions
- Aspen Highlands Ski Area shuttle depot
- Conundrum Hot Springs permits
- Bear safety and Leave No Trace
- Maroon Bells Amphitheater events
- U.S. Forest Service regulations

## Essential Information & Reservations

- [Maroon Bells Shuttle & Parking Reservations](https://www.visitmaroonbells.com): Homepage for Maroon Bells shuttle and parking reservations system
- [Questions About The Maroon Bells](https://www.visitmaroonbells.com/about-the-maroon-bells): General info about Maroon Peak and North Maroon Peak in Elk Mountains
- [Round Trip Reverse Shuttle](https://www.visitmaroonbells.com/reverse-round-trip): Reverse shuttle booking from Maroon Lake Trailhead to Aspen Highlands

## Transportation & Access

- [Maroon Bells - Shuttle Bus Questions](https://www.visitmaroonbells.com/maroon-bells-shuttle-bus-questions): FAQ on shuttle service from Aspen Highlands to Maroon Bells Welcome Center
- [Questions on Bike Access, Private Drop Offs, and Ride Shares](https://www.visitmaroonbells.com/questions-on-areas-outside-maroon-bells): FAQ on bike access, e-bikes, and ride-sharing on Maroon Creek Road

## Camping & Backpacking

- [Maroon Bells - Campground Questions](https://www.visitmaroonbells.com/maroon-bells-camping-questions): FAQ about camping at Silver Bar, Silver Queen, and Silver Bell sites
- [Maroon Bells - Backpacking Questions](https://www.visitmaroonbells.com/maroon-bells-backpacking-questions): FAQ on wilderness permits for Four Pass Loop and Conundrum Hot Springs

## Recreation Activities

- [Maroon Bells - Hunting & Fishing Questions](https://www.visitmaroonbells.com/maroon-bells-hunting-questions): FAQ about hunting and fishing regulations in Maroon Bells Wilderness

## Special Use & Events

- [School Field Trips to Maroon Bells](https://www.visitmaroonbells.com/school-field-trips): Educational field trip info with ACES and U.S. Forest Service guidelines
- [Maroon Bells - Weddings and Amphitheater Questions](https://www.visitmaroonbells.com/maroon-bells-weddings-and-amphitheater-questions): FAQ on wedding events and Maroon Bells Amphitheater reservations
